harness_contract.intent: Demonstrate the C10 native observations acceptance route end to end: build a real mumei.native-bundle/v1 from an atom that returns 0 without writing stdout or stderr, so the bundle pins exit status and both empty output channels; run `python -m agent native-observations-accept` and show one invocation matching all three pins, then show a wrong build ID produces no claimed outcome.
artifact_contracts: Read inputs: scenarios/native_observations_accept/src/main.mm (the bounded native profile atom main() -> i64 requires: true).
Step 1 runs `native-bundle build`, verifies the record pins exit status 0 plus the SHA-256 of empty stdout and stderr, and records sha256(native-bundle.json) as the trusted-channel build ID.
Step 2 runs the declared `native-observations-accept` route and asserts report.acceptance == 'accepted', all three channel checks plus runtime_observation_semantics, and the echoed expected_build_id.
Step 3 reruns the route with a wrong build ID and asserts no claimed outcome, full C02/runtime checks_not_performed and normalized exit_code 1.

name: Declared Native Observations Acceptance (native-observations-accept)
description: C02/C10 runtime-observation acceptance demo: the declared `native-observations-accept` route runs `native-bundle accept-observations` as one attempt — `acceptance: accepted` plus `artifact_semantics`, `claim_truth`, all three OS channel checks, and `runtime_observation_semantics` from the same invocation; a wrong build ID leaves the full C02/runtime family unperformed.

intro: Step 1: Build a bundle with pinned observations.
Step 2: Check the declared observation fields.
Step 3: Try a mismatched build ID.
narrative.before: The declared route boundary has not yet been checked.
narrative.after: Only the route's declared fields are checked; broader guarantees are not claimed.
narrative.moment: One Core invocation checks pinned channels; no universal ABI/runtime claim.

result_message: Result: One Core call; wrong pin claims nothing.

intent_fidelity.source_intent: Show the declared native-observations-accept route executing a real bundle's byte-identical reproduced program once and matching its exit status, stdout and stderr pins in that one invocation, then refusing to claim an outcome for a wrong build ID.
success_criteria: report.json carries mumei.native-observations-accept-report/v1 with acceptance == 'accepted', discharged_checks == ['artifact_semantics', 'claim_truth', 'os_exit_status_observation', 'os_stderr_observation', 'os_stdout_observation', 'runtime_observation_semantics'], checks_not_performed == ['file_identity', 'freshness', 'producer_authenticity', 'semantic_correspondence'], and expected_build_id equal to sha256(native-bundle.json)

wrong_report.json carries no acceptance or discharged_checks, checks_not_performed == ['artifact_semantics', 'claim_truth', 'file_identity', 'freshness', 'os_exit_status_observation', 'os_stderr_observation', 'os_stdout_observation', 'producer_authenticity', 'runtime_observation_semantics', 'semantic_correspondence'], no selected_result and normalized exit_code 1

steps.name: Produce a native bundle with all three runtime pins
steps.command: {mumei_bin} native-bundle build {root_dir}/scenarios/native_observations_accept/src/main.mm -o {output_dir}/bundle > {output_dir}/build.log 2>&1 && python3 -c "import hashlib,json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/bundle/native-bundle.json')); p=r['link_build']; empty=hashlib.sha256(b'').hexdigest(); assert p['expected_exit_status']==0, p; assert p['expected_stdout_sha256']==empty, p; assert p['expected_stderr_sha256']==empty, p; print(hashlib.sha256(open('{output_dir}/bundle/native-bundle.json','rb').read()).hexdigest())" > {output_dir}/build_id.txt; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/build.log; cat {output_dir}/build_id.txt; test $rc -eq 0
steps.artifact_contract: build_id.txt holds sha256(native-bundle.json); link_build pins exit status 0 and the empty stdout/stderr digests; bundle/ holds all five declared members.
steps.verifier_gate: native-bundle build exits 0 and the complete record contains all three runtime observation pins.

steps.name: native-observations-accept reports all runtime observations accepted
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent native-observations-accept --core {mumei_bin} --bundle {output_dir}/bundle --source {root_dir}/scenarios/native_observations_accept/src/main.mm --expected-build-id $(cat {output_dir}/build_id.txt) --output {output_dir}/report.json > {output_dir}/accept.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/report.json; cat {output_dir}/accept.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/report.json')); assert r['schema_version']=='mumei.native-observations-accept-report/v1', r['schema_version']; assert r['acceptance']=='accepted', r; assert r['discharged_checks']==['artifact_semantics', 'claim_truth', 'os_exit_status_observation', 'os_stderr_observation', 'os_stdout_observation', 'runtime_observation_semantics'], r; assert r['checks_not_performed']==['file_identity', 'freshness', 'producer_authenticity', 'semantic_correspondence'], r; assert r['expected_build_id']==open('{output_dir}/build_id.txt').read().strip(), r; assert r['sequence'].get('selected_result') is not None; assert 'candidate' not in r; print('native-observations-accept: accepted all three channel observations and runtime_observation_semantics')"
steps.artifact_contract: report.json holds mumei.native-observations-accept-report/v1 with all three channel observations and runtime_observation_semantics discharged from one invocation; expected_build_id is echoed.
steps.verifier_gate: native-observations-accept exits 0; the one reproduced invocation matched the bundle's exit-status, stdout and stderr pins.

steps.name: Wrong build ID claims no outcome
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent native-observations-accept --core {mumei_bin} --bundle {output_dir}/bundle --source {root_dir}/scenarios/native_observations_accept/src/main.mm --expected-build-id $(python3 -c "import hashlib;print(hashlib.sha256(b'not-the-build-id').hexdigest())") --output {output_dir}/wrong_report.json > {output_dir}/wrong.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/wrong_report.json; cat {output_dir}/wrong.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import hashlib,json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/wrong_report.json')); assert r['schema_version']=='mumei.native-observations-accept-report/v1'; assert 'acceptance' not in r; assert 'discharged_checks' not in r; assert r['expected_build_id']==hashlib.sha256(b'not-the-build-id').hexdigest(), r; assert r['checks_not_performed']==['artifact_semantics', 'claim_truth', 'file_identity', 'freshness', 'os_exit_status_observation', 'os_stderr_observation', 'os_stdout_observation', 'producer_authenticity', 'runtime_observation_semantics', 'semantic_correspondence'], r; assert r['sequence'].get('selected_result') is None; assert r['normalized'].get('exit_code') == 1, r['normalized']; print('wrong build ID: no claimed outcome, exit 1')"
steps.artifact_contract: wrong_report.json holds no acceptance or discharged_checks, full C02/runtime checks_not_performed, no selected_result, normalized exit_code 1, and the echoed wrong expected_build_id.
steps.verifier_gate: The mismatched build ID exits 1 — no claimed outcome.
